panel_intro: The school configures forms and defines delivery to guardians: either all guardians of students in selected classes, or the guardian linked to each student in named mode. Submissions are recorded here within {{module}}.
fill_empty_staff: Only the public form with the exact title «{{title}}» appears here. Create or activate that template under «School forms» (above); other titles remain in management only.
fill_empty_user: The school does not yet have an active form titled «{{title}}» in this area.
history_edit_permission_hint: To edit submitted responses you need Administrator, Super-admin, Leadership, Secretariat or Treasury profile — aligned with system permissions.
history_empty: No submissions yet within your access.
dialog_form_desc: Set the title, delivery to guardians and fields. For dropdown, radio and multiple checkboxes use one option per line.
recipient_section_intro: Notifications (email and push) are sent to guardians’ PARENT profiles. By class, all guardians of students in those classes are notified; in named mode, confirm the guardian linked to each student on every row.
recipient_mode_classroom_title: Guardians of students in selected classes
recipient_mode_classroom_hint: All guardians of students enrolled in the classes you choose below receive notification (email and push) and can complete the form.
recipient_mode_named_hint: For each row, specify the student: the form is sent to that student’s linked guardian.
classroom_year_hint: List limited to the school year selected globally in the header{{yearSuffix}}.
pick_year_header: Select the school year in the app header to choose classes.
no_classrooms_year: No classes registered at this school for {{year}}.
no_guardian_for_student: No guardian linked to this student
staff_correction_desc: You can change responses, signatures or attachments for this submission. Template fields, student and original author stay the same. Audit logs user, time and previous/new content (Administrator › Audit logs).
no_field_structure: No field structure available for this form.
toast_no_fields_export: The form has no fields to export.
toast_no_fields_pdf: No field structure available for this PDF.
toast_field_min_options: «{{label}}»: for lists/radio/checkboxes, enter at least two options (one per line).
toast_student_needs_guardian: Each selected student must have a linked guardian in the system.
toast_confirm_guardian: On each row, confirm the guardian for the selected student.
toast_add_named_row: Add at least one row with student and guardian.
toast_notifications_sent: {{count}} notification(s) sent (email and push per guardian preferences).
toast_form_id_error: Could not get the form id.
toast_no_fields_correct: No fields available to correct this submission.
toast_no_fields_save_correction: No fields available to save this correction.
toast_correction_saved: Submission corrected by administration. The change was recorded for audit.
